banks.title: Listening GT Section 2: Informasi Festival Kuliner dan Kerajinan

questions.prompt: Why has the festival moved to a new location this year?
questions.explanation_id: Festival dipindahkan ke Victoria Park "because of the road works on the high street".
options: The Market Square is being redeveloped
There are road works on the high street
The festival has grown too large
correct_answers: There are road works on the high street

questions.prompt:
Complete the notes. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER.

Gates open at: ________ a.m.
questions.explanation_id: Gerbang dibuka "at nine thirty in the morning". Pukul sembilan yang tercetak di program adalah salah cetak.

questions.prompt: Number of stalls this year: more than ________
questions.explanation_id: Tahun lalu sekitar 50 kios, tahun ini "more than eighty".

questions.prompt: Where in Victoria Park will each of the following be?
questions.explanation_id: Tenda kerajinan anak "in the rose garden" (bukan dekat pintu masuk seperti tahun lalu), panggung musik "beside the lake", dan pos P3K "next to the car park" agar ambulans mudah masuk.

questions.prompt: Visitors who want a drink should bring a reusable ________.
questions.explanation_id: Kios tidak lagi memberi gelas sekali pakai: "please remember to bring a reusable cup with you".

questions.prompt: Choose TWO letters. Which TWO ways of travelling to the festival do the organisers recommend?
questions.explanation_id: Penyelenggara menyarankan "the free shuttle bus" dari stasiun dan "to cycle". Parkir terbatas dan taksi tidak bisa ke gerbang karena Park Lane ditutup.
options: Driving and using the park car park
Taking a taxi to the gate

questions.explanation_id: Anak di bawah 16 tahun gratis, sedangkan "adults are asked to pay three pounds at the gate".

questions.prompt: Where will the money from ticket sales go?
questions.explanation_id: Seluruh hasil penjualan tiket "will go to the Westbridge Hospice".

questions.prompt: Volunteers are needed to help with setting up on ________ evening.
questions.explanation_id: Relawan dibutuhkan "to help with setting up on Friday evening" dan memungut sampah selama festival.
